text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Mallet Finger (rupture of the extensor tendon at the DIP joint).

The inability to actively extend the distal interphalangeal joint with the finger resting in flexion is the classic presentation of this injury. Have you noticed any bruising on the tip of the finger or a visible step-off in the nail bed?

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
